messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary above to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The job posting requires 8 years of backend engineering experience, but the candidate summary you provided does not specify any number of years.  

Please provide the total years of backend engineering experience. Without stating this, your application may be filtered out or passed over, since many recruiters and automated systems require an explicit match to the stated experience requirement.  

Once you provide this detail, I can revise your summary accordingly.
